title: Jewellery & Gold Wholesale in Istanbul: Kuyumcukent vs Grand Bazaar
seoTitle: Jewellery Sourcing Istanbul: Kuyumcukent vs Grand Bazaar

quickAnswer: International buyers sourcing gold and fine jewellery in Istanbul split between Kuyumcukent's 328,000-square-metre industrial manufacturing complex in Yenibosna and the historic artisan workshops around the Grand Bazaar in Fatih. Kuyumcukent suits volume casting, OEM export orders, and modern security, while Grand Bazaar ateliers excel at small-batch handmade pieces, stone-setting, and heritage finishes.

body.text: How does Kuyumcukent's modern manufacturing complex differ from Grand Bazaar workshops?

Kuyumcukent in Yenibosna is an integrated industrial complex spanning 328,000 square metres with roughly 2,500 production units and more than 400 trade stores built for high-volume export manufacturing, casting, and refining. Grand Bazaar workshops in Fatih cluster in historic hans, focusing on small-batch bench work, hand-forged settings, custom prototyping, and traditional Ottoman or filigree metalwork.

Choosing between the two hubs depends on order volume, tooling requirements, and turnaround speed. According to the [Kuyumcukent Overview](https://www.kuyumcukent.com.tr/en/overview) and [Istanbul Jewelry Show production guide](https://www.istanbuljewelryshow.com/ijs-blog/jewelry-production-centres-in-turkey/), Kuyumcukent houses large-scale factories capable of CAD/CAM prototyping, laser soldering, and consistent karat tolerances for European, Gulf, and North American chains. By contrast, multi-generational studios around Çemberlitaş and Nuruosmaniye near the Grand Bazaar accommodate lower minimum order quantities and bespoke hand-engraving.

body.text: What hallmarking, customs and export rules apply to gold and diamond buyers?

Commercial gold and diamond exports from Türkiye must clear formal customs procedures through a licensed Turkish customs broker using commercial invoices, packing lists, karat purity documentation, and destination-market hallmarking standards. Personal passenger baggage allowances of up to USD 15,000 apply strictly to non-commercial personal ornaments, never to wholesale trade inventory or investment bullion.

As outlined in the [Republic of Türkiye Ministry of Trade Turkish Jewellery Industry profile](https://trade.gov.tr/data/5b8fd5bf13b8761f041fee9b/5b9dd842b4b35990b0de2fe4b3f2a044.pdf), Türkiye consistently ranks among the world's top five gold jewellery producers. Buyers should note that unprocessed gold imports and bullion flows are strictly regulated through the [Borsa İstanbul Precious Metals Market](https://borsaistanbul.com/files/precious-metals-and-diamond-market-procedure-31-pro-11.pdf), while personal passenger declarations follow the [Ministry of Trade USD 15,000 threshold](https://halilbakirci.av.tr/en/gold-jewelry-turkey-customs-15000-usd-passenger-rule-2026/).

[Itinerary of Türkiye](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/) is an independent, client-paid, flat-fee advisory run by its two founders in Türkiye ("Paid by our clients. Independent of provider commissions."). We coordinate factory schedules, transfers, and vetted introductions; formal tax structuring, legal contracts, customs brokerage, hallmarking certifications, and regulatory filings belong strictly to licensed Turkish attorneys, SMMMs (CPAs), customs brokers, and official authorities.
When does the Istanbul Jewelry Show take place?

The Istanbul Jewelry Show (IJS) runs twice annually at the Istanbul Expo Center (İFM) in Yeşilköy, with one spring edition in late March or early April and one autumn edition in late September or early October. In 2026, IJS ran April 1–4 and September 30–October 3, with the next spring edition set for March 31–April 3, 2027.

Organized by Informa Markets, [IJS Istanbul Jewelry Show](https://www.istanbuljewelryshow.com/overview/show-information/) ranks among the top five global B2B jewellery trade fairs. Because Yeşilköy sits just 15 to 25 minutes from Kuyumcukent, many international buyers pair two days on the [Istanbul Expo Center](https://ifm.com.tr/en/fairs/ijs-istanbul-jewelry-show-international-jewelry-watch-and-equipment-fair-2026) floor with two days of private factory audits in Yenibosna and Fatih. Booking hotels and chauffeured transport six to eight weeks ahead avoids trade-week surges.
What security and private-transfer precautions apply?

Jewellery buyers moving between Yeşilköy, Kuyumcukent, and the Grand Bazaar should avoid public transit or street-hailed taxis when carrying samples, cash, or high-value trade paperwork. Pre-booked private transfers with vetted drivers, staggered appointment schedules, discreet packaging, and insured armoured couriers for commercial shipments significantly reduce transit exposure across Istanbul.
Use this practical field checklist when preparing a sourcing itinerary:

items: Pre-vetted appointments: Confirm workshop block numbers, floor units, and entry passes before arrival at Kuyumcukent.
Zero sample carry in transit: Ship commercial stock through licensed bonded couriers and customs brokers rather than checked luggage.
Discreet movement: Use unbranded private vehicles and avoid discussing order values or metal weights in hotel lobbies.
Split-day routing: Group Yenibosna and Yeşilköy meetings on one day and Fatih historic-peninsula workshops on another to beat cross-city traffic.
Independent accompaniment: Work with a flat-fee coordinator who takes no vendor commission, keeping supplier comparisons objective.

faq.q: Can foreign retail buyers enter Kuyumcukent workshops without an appointment?
faq.a: Kuyumcukent's shopping mall is open to the public, but most wholesale casting houses and export studios inside the Workshop Block operate strictly B2B and require pre-arranged appointments and trade credentials.

faq.q: What purity standards are standard in Istanbul gold wholesale?
faq.a: Turkish export manufacturers routinely produce 8K (333), 9K (375), 14K (585), 18K (750), 21K (875), and 22K (916) gold depending on destination market rules and buyer specifications.

faq.q: Can I carry commercial gold wholesale stock in personal luggage out of Istanbul?
faq.a: No. While personal jewelry up to USD 15,000 follows passenger declaration rules, commercial wholesale stock requires formal export customs declarations, commercial invoices, and licensed customs brokerage.

faq.q: How far is Kuyumcukent from Istanbul Expo Center during the Istanbul Jewelry Show?
faq.a: Both venues sit on Istanbul's western European side near Yenibosna and Yeşilköy, typically 15 to 25 minutes apart by private vehicle depending on E-5 highway traffic.

faq.q: Does Itinerary of Türkiye take commissions from jewellery wholesalers?
faq.a: No. Itinerary of Türkiye is a flat-fee advisory paid solely by its clients and accepts zero commissions, referral fees, or kickbacks from workshops, brokers, or hotels.

faq.q: Who handles hallmarking compliance and customs clearance for gold exports?
faq.a: Licensed Turkish customs brokers, accredited assay offices, and trade attorneys handle export declarations, hallmarking documentation, and destination-country import compliance.
